title: Smiling speech bubble
slide_intent: Show how one expressive image can set the tone for a chapter about speaking to people. A facial gesture gives the message a recognizable mood.
strategic_value: Slack can connect conversational language with a visual expression of friendliness as the book turns to voice and tone.
demonstration: A white dimensional speech bubble with a curved smile and two eyes fills a salmon-colored page. Black edges and a shadow give it volume.
practical_value: Use a simple communicative symbol with a facial cue when a transition needs to convey tone before introducing detailed guidance.

content_islands.name: Speech bubble
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the white bubble near the center of the colored field and point its tail toward the lower right. Use the ground color for its smile and eyes, with a black rim and offset shadow for depth.
